verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS equity-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no self-hosted or on-premises deployment option. Every documented access path is Carta's hosted API, its playground/production environments, the hosted data warehouse, or the MCP plugins, all of which connect to Carta's own service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
